# Fraud And Scam Detection

## When to use
Use when the task requires review online earning proposals for scams, impossible promises, illegal or unsafe actions and unresolved compliance risks.

## Procedure
Check upfront payment for work, fake jobs, credential harvesting, prohibited geographic workarounds, unrealistic ROI, payout release fees, suspicious payment instructions and manipulated testimonials. Flag red/amber/green without defamation; serious red flags block approval. Never perform risky verification payments.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
